The cover-cost and endpoint order steps satisfy the conditions in BG001–BG002. There are no E/M applications.

H001 provides x0∈E, so f(t)=(x0,t) lies in F. The stipulated Euclidean formula gives distance |t-u|. Pullbacks of intersections of any countable δ-cover with f(I) cover I and have no greater diameters, yielding the stated content and measure inequalities. Infinity from N003 transfers to F; N001 then bounds its dimension below by every 0<s<1. BG002 justifies the endpoint without any exchange of limits. Under D=0, D is finite and D+1=1. For n=0 the same formula holds with zero distance in the singleton ℝ^0.
